dedupe_keys.name: magic2 mappa della gerarchizzazione dei punti di criticita pc mar tirreno meridionale canale di sicilia mar ionio occidentale rndt dataset versione 2 0

description: The Italian Department of Civil Protection and CNR-IGAG publish MaGIC2 classifications of critical points previously mapped by MaGIC1. The existing southern Tyrrhenian, Sicily Channel and western Ionian map is joined by maps for the Tyrrhenian/Adriatic/Ionian sector, Ligurian Sea and Sardinian Sea, plus their vector critical-point representation. Native lineage explicitly defines these points as locations where geological phenomena could, in the interpreter’s judgement, damage surrounding infrastructure or coastal communities. The source distinguishes canyon/channel heads, landslides, tectonic features, volcanoes and fluid escape, with additional unclassifiable and other cases. Classification is relative within each category and must not be compared across different hazard types. The vector abstract describes identifiers, category, a 0–3 classification value and colour. It refers to 73 source sheets; this is not an additive count of new mapped areas. Maps and vectors overlap and are grouped as one classification product. Native metadata dated 2016–2017 lists TIFF and Shapefile, CC BY 4.0 and no public-access limitation. File-use costs remain unknown. The provider states that infrastructure inventories and complete risk assessment are unavailable, that observations are heterogeneous, and that the products are unsuitable for navigation. No event probability, engineering design load, particular infrastructure simulation or current condition is established. Related MaGIC1 critical-point layers supply the source features. Earlier links are retained; no map, feature, archive or code body was read.
